H - OUR  neighbourhood

Elevate Your Executive Presence

At Hour Space, we take care of the space. You take care of the work.

At Hour Space, we believe that the right environment acts as a catalyst for growth. And when you need a breather, our outdoor area is right there waiting.

Work and Wellness - Impact of Aesthetic Spaces

There's something about a co-working space that's been thoughtfully put together - the way it quietly shifts your mood before you've even opened your laptop.
The soft hum of focused work around you. Natural light. Greenery at the edges of your vision. People nearby who are just as deep in their work as you are. It doesn't feel like a big deal until you notice how much better your day went.
That's the thing about aesthetic spaces - they don't just look good. They make you feel good. And when you feel good, the work follows.
At Hour Space, that's never been an accident. Every corner has been designed with your well being in mind just as much as your productivity - because the two were never meant to be separate.
Come work somewhere that works for you.

It started with a promise. When we were in the thick of construction - walls going up, ideas taking shape. We told you we were building something different. Not just another coworking space, but a place designed around the way you actually work.
And now, we're adding that layer.
Introducing our private 2-seater and 4-seater cabins -  fully enclosed, beautifully finished headquarters for the ones who need to put their heads down and build. featured_reviews.name: Chintani Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Summary: No space for discussion, no space for silence!

They have no space to take calls except for 3 uncomfortable phone booths. These do not fulfill the requirement of such a large office, so people have no option but to take calls elsewhere - which is not permitted!

There is no space except the pantry for a team to have short discussions. I understand the need to book a meeting room for a formal meeting, but how does a team function without any conversation all day?

Worst of all, they advertise 'Silent Zone' on their website. However, people have full-fledged, loud discussions and calls in these zones. When we inform the staff, we are told to mention specific cabin numbers, write e-mails, etc. Is it our responsibility to report others throughout the day?

They have a lovely deck overlooking the ocean, but they restrict entry to it! Instead of creating a progressive system to monitor authorized entry to the workspace, they decide to add restrictions at every stage, which makes the work experience rather unpleasant.

The location gives this the potential to become the best co-working space in the city. If they would simply demarcate one Silent Zone for people who actually need silence and open other spaces for in-team discussions, collaboration would become very simple indeed.

P.S. - I guess those who have booked full cabins for their company have a slightly better experience in terms of calls/silence, but I don't think others should be treated as second-class citizens or lured with the promise of a Silent Zone, which is anything but one!

P.P.S. - Also, they have really bad coffee and tea!

You can also share your feedback in detail along with your contact details at we-in-48093@wework.co.in so that the concerned team can get in touch with you.
